def equation(t, P, params):
    c=np.abs(params[9])+1e-9
    G = t**params[8]/(c**params[8]+t**params[8])
    return (params[0]*G + params[1]*P + params[2]*P*t + params[3]*P*G + params[4]*P**2 + params[5]*P**2*G
            + params[6]*P**2*t + params[7]*P**3 + params[8]*0 + 0*P)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    G = np.tanh(params[9]*t)
    return (params[0]*G + params[1]*P*t + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*P**2*t + params[4]*P
            + params[5]*P*G + params[6]*P**2*G + params[7]*P**3*G + params[8]*t*(G-1) + params[0]*0
            + 0*P)
